record.paper_title: Problems and Conjectures in Matrix and Operator Inequalities
record.original_question: For positive semidefinite matrices A and B and a real parameter p>0, is each singular value of A^pB^(1-p)+B^pA^(1-p) bounded above by the corresponding singular value of A+B? In other words, does σ_i(A^pB^(1-p)+B^pA^(1-p)) ≤ σ_i(A+B) hold for every index i?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A$ and $B$ be $n\times n$ positive semidefinite complex matrices, and let $p>0$ be a real parameter. For an $n\times n$ matrix $X$, let $\sigma_1(X)\ge\sigma_2(X)\ge\cdots\ge\sigma_n(X)\ge 0$ denote the singular values of $X$ arranged in decreasing order. Determine whether the inequality
$$\sigma_i\bigl(A^{p}B^{1-p}+B^{p}A^{1-p}\bigr)\;\le\;\sigma_i(A+B)$$
holds for every index $i\in\{1,2,\ldots,n\}$, for all positive semidefinite $A,B$, and for all $p>0$.
artifact.status_search_result: This is a singular-value strengthening of a well-known question of Bourin. The unitarily invariant norm version has been confirmed only for specific exponents (notably $p=1/4$ and $p=3/4$, due to Hayajneh–Kittaneh) and partial norm bounds have been obtained for $t\in[3/4,1]$ with a constant factor. The full singular-value inequality for arbitrary $p>0$ appears to remain open as of recent literature (2022–2024).

status_evidence.title: Remarks on a Question of Bourin for Positive Semidefinite Matrices
status_evidence.snippet: For t∈[3/4,1] and every unitarily invariant norm, ‖A^t B^{1-t}+B^t A^{1-t}‖ ≤ 2^{2(t-3/4)} ‖A+B‖, related to an open question of Bourin.
status_evidence.claim: The inequality is known only with constants or for special exponents; the general case is referred to as an open question of Bourin.

status_evidence.title: Norm inequalities for positive semidefinite matrices and a question of Bourin III
status_evidence.snippet: Affirmative solution of Bourin's question for t=1/4 and 3/4 due to Hayajneh and Kittaneh.
status_evidence.claim: Only special cases of the inequality are known to be settled.
